title: quercus croatica var. typica
intro: Quercus croatica var. typica, commonly known as the Balkan white oak, is a deciduous tree species native to the Balkan Peninsula. It is a variety of the Quercus croatica tree and is prized for its medicinal properties. The bark and leaves of the Balkan white oak are used in traditional medicine and have been found to have health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of Quercus croatica var. typica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
